To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated a method for high-accuracy ground target geo-location using an autonomous micro aerial vehicle equipped with a video sensor.

(1) The proposed method is suitable for MAV platforms due to their limited capabilities; (2) The proposed method can achieve a target geo-location accuracy of 2 meters or better, which is sufficient for a wide range of target tracking applications; and (3) The proposed method does not require the knowledge of aircraft position and attitude.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a system that is able to autonomously detect, track, identify, and geo-locate a moving or stationary ground target using a MAV platform.
developing a method for ground object localization using a MAV platform.

the following topics: (a) the development of an autonomous MAV platform capable of high precision ground target geolocation, (b) the development of the image registration technique, (c) the development of a method for ground target detection in the video image, (d) the development of methods for the estimation of the aircraft position, attitude and altitude, and (e) the development of algorithms for the integration of the image processing and navigation systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method is a viable solution for high accuracy ground geo-location using MAV platforms.
the proposed method is capable to provide accurate ground target localization with a MAV platform.
the proposed method provides high accuracy ground target geo-location without requiring any accurate knowledge of the MAV position or attitude.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully demonstrated the capability of using an autonomous MAV platform with a low-cost video camera to perform high accuracy target localization in real time.
we have demonstrated that a small MAV can be used as a platform for high accuracy ground geo-location using a video camera sensor only.
we have demonstrated a method for ground target geo-location using a MAV equipped with a video sensor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the accuracy of a MAV-based geolocation system can be improved using image registration techniques, even with a relatively low-cost video sensor.
a low cost MAV platform can perform high accuracy ground target geolocation using an image registration technique.
a simple and inexpensive MAV platform can achieve a ground target localization accuracy comparable with that of a high-end UAV.
